# function: organizations_handshake

Builds the ARN of an `organizations` `handshake`:

```
arn:${Partition}:organizations::${Account}:handshake/o-${OrganizationId}/${HandshakeType}/h-${HandshakeId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
organizations_handshake(organization_id string, handshake_type string, handshake_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `organization_id` (String) Value for `${OrganizationId}` in the ARN template.
1. `handshake_type` (String) Value for `${HandshakeType}` in the ARN template.
1. `handshake_id` (String) Value for `${HandshakeId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
